title: Draw the paired sprites for the robot's three jobs
ask: Daniel ruled Q-87 option a: the robot's menu shows paired sprites — the robot beside the thing it deals with — instead of the words "Chase birds off", "Follow me", "Circle me". That removes the first required reading added since the shop was stripped of it, and it gives every machine after this one the same vocabulary.
first_action: Draw three paired cells on the existing sprite sheet: robot+crow, robot+farmer, robot+farmer-with-a-ring. Reuse the art that exists rather than drawing new subjects.
source_message: Daniel ruled Q-87 option a: the robot's menu shows paired sprites — the robot beside the thing it deals with — instead of the words "Chase birds off", "Follow me", "Circle me". That removes the first required reading added since the shop was stripped of it, and it gives every machine after this one the same vocabulary.
result: Three 48×32 robot job icons are ready: Mark II with a crow, Mark II with the farmer, and Mark II with the farmer inside a gold ring. They reuse shipped sprite pixels; the crow has a light edge so it reads on the dark menu. The atlas, reproducible builder, import file, design note and provenance landed on main in commit f937a72. No Retro Diffusion call or credit was used. Godot imported the atlas; isolated runs passed 2,859 unit and 969 integration checks. The separate menu-swap card still needs to put these icons in front of players.

landed.note: Three paired job icons landed; menu wiring remains separate.
